title: A Orbit for the Vector
author: Odile Amberdale
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
